item.title: Stripper claims U.S. troops revealing deployment details
item.description: A U.S. dancer has claimed that young American servicemen are disclosing details of upcoming deployments while visiting strip clubs, raising concerns about operational security.

item.title: Trump signals possible U.S. exit from NATO
item.description: President Donald Trump has indicated that he is weighing the possibility of withdrawing the United States from NATO, intensifying his criticism of alliance members over their stance on the conflict with Iran.

item.title: Parking warden hurt in Nathan Road motorcycle clash
item.description: A traffic warden was injured in Tsim Sha Tsui on Tuesday afternoon after being assaulted while issuing a fixed penalty notice to a motorcyclist suspected of illegal parking.

item.title: Visa survey finds 88% of Hong Kong travellers to maintain or raise spending
item.description: A new study by Visa has found that 88 per cent of Hong Kong residents who travel abroad intend to maintain or increase their holiday spending despite shifts in the economic climate, underscoring the extent to which overseas travel has become embedded in everyday life.

item.title: Fans comment on visible facial changes in Hins Cheung and Charlene Choi
item.description: Hong Kong pop stars Hins Cheung, 45, and Charlene Choi, 42, have sparked widespread discussion online after recent interview appearances prompted comments about noticeable changes in their appearance.

item.title: Hong Kong treats travel like rent as Japan feels close
item.description: A Visa survey finds 88% of Hong Kong outbound travellers plan to maintain or raise holiday spending even in a shifting economy. This opinion piece explores why travel has become a necessity in a high pressure city where Tin Shui Wai feels far while Taiwan seems near and Japan feels nearer still.
